<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
  <h2>About Me</h2>
</div>

<div style="text-align:justify; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
<p>
Dr. Abraham Holland is a Senior Director in research and development for Vizient, a provider-driven healthcare performance improvement company. Vizient serves 97% of academic medical centers, more than two-thirds of acute care providers, and one-third of ambulatory providers in the United States. Dr. Holland is also an adjunct researcher at the Institute for Defense Analyses (IDA). At IDA, Dr. Holland is an applied microeconomist supporting analyses across strategic resource allocation and resilience topics. He also co-founded the Institute’s Strategic Planning for Actionable Resilience Working Group, which applies cutting-edge science to national security challenges. A U.S. Air Force veteran, Dr. Holland earned his Ph.D. in Public Policy from Harvard University in 2019. His dissertation research developed randomized experiments and empirical methods to evaluate the social and economic impacts of public service delivery failures and to improve public sector efficiency. He also graduated summa cum laude from Dartmouth College with a bachelor’s degree in economics and Chinese literature.
</p>
